title: introduce-ghost-connection-guard-and-slo-leaky-window-hotfix
description:
Motivation: During a recent regional failover incident we observed a small class of connections that remained 'zombie' (inflight but not progressing) and continued to hold slots on serving nodes, exacerbating SLO breaches and causing noisy autoscale events. This PR introduces two coordinated changes: 1) a lightweight Ghost Connection Guard that detects and evacuates stalled in-flight connections during regional failover and rapid drain windows; and 2) an SLO leaky-window smoothing algorithm for tiered egress shedding decisions to avoid abrupt swings when transient bursts hit regional capacity. Additionally this contains a small hotfix for a KV cache drain race that could amplify latency spikes when connections were force-evicted. The description below covers design, tests, rollout plan and checklists.

Design summary: Ghost Connection Guard: runs in the connection orchestrator and identifies connections that have made no progress on token generation for a configurable window (default 15s) while the node is in a draining state or during a regional soft-failover. Identified ghosts are soft-fenced: requests receive a 202/Retry-After with a telemetry tag and the KV cache for that session is preserved and scheduled for background reattach. The guard emits detailed telemetry to help correlate stuck connections with model slowpaths, network flaps, or kernel stalls.

SLO Leaky-Window for shedding: replaces the binary immediate-threshold logic with a leaky-window accumulator that decays over a configurable half-life. The shedder now considers both instantaneous load and the leaky-window score before moving tenants between egress tiers; this reduces oscillation and enables graceful ramp-down/upsweep policies tied to the tenant's SLO weight.

KV cache drain hotfix: fixes a race where background KV eviction could double-free session handles during concurrent drain + reattach, causing latency spikes and ephemeral panics. The fix adds a tiny reference-counting guard and a deferred background worker to avoid synchronous work on the hot path.

Checklist: [x] design doc updated (docs/ops/regional-failover-mitigation.md) [x] unit + integration tests for leaky-window and guard [x] telemetry keys added and dashboards sketched [x] smoke rollout plan documented under release notes [x] hotfix backported to release/2026-02 branch for immediate rollout

Testing: added unit tests for the accumulator math and connection classification; added an integration harness that simulates a partial regional egress cut and verifies requests transition with expected Retry-After behavior and KV reattach scheduling. Load tests show a 42% reduction in oscillatory shedding events in synthetic burst scenarios.

Rollout: feature-flagged (FF_GHOST_CONN_GUARD, FF_SLO_LEAKY_WINDOW) on canary for 48 hours, then staged region rollout with telemetry SLO gates. Hotfix for KV drain is being applied to release branches immediately and validated in the US-west canary.

Related: linear: ENG-2332, ENG-2380. This addresses customer incident INC-2026-011 (internal).
author: Priya Malhotra
commits: feat(shedder): add leaky-window accumulator and decay config
feat(conn): implement ghost connection classifier and soft-fence flow
fix(kv): add refcount guard to KV drain worker to prevent double-free
docs(ops): add regional failover mitigation guide and rollout playbook
review_threads: Ethan Cho: Logged some questions about the 15s default window — can we make it auto-scale based on average token throughput?
Author(Priya Malhotra): Answered — added adaptive_multiplier config; default remains 15s to be conservative. Added note in docs.
Sofia García: Can the soft-fence cause a negative UX by returning 202 too often? What about augmenting with a short local retry?
Author: Agreed; implemented a local 200ms transient retry before soft-fence and documented reasoning. Added a unit test for transient progress detection.
Liam O'Connor: CI flake on integration harness observed — integration test relies on timing; switched to event-based probe and re-ran tests.
Ethan Cho: Approved pending minor telemetry key naming change. Priya: renamed keys and updated dashboards.
release_notes: Introduces Ghost Connection Guard (feature-flagged) to detect and evacuate stalled in-flight connections during drain/failover windows and a leaky-window SLO accumulator to smooth tiered egress shedding decisions. Includes a KV drain race hotfix. Rollout via feature flag; hotfix backported to release branch.
